purpose: Carry the live, append-only, role-scoped execution and access state for the parser-v3-v2 set-repair lifecycle, so that the FINAL Phase 1.2G acceptance policy never has to be edited to record that something happened.

policy_binding.bytes_modified_note: One block changed: review_provenance. Audit A and Audit B were listed without finding counts while C, D and E carried them, and the limitation asserted that the Audit E remediation had not been re-reviewed, which Phase 1.2H made false by re-reviewing it. No threshold, gate, population figure, ontology entry, comparator role, status rule or execution_state value was touched.
policy_binding.note: policy_semantics_sha256 is computed over the policy with the five mutable execution_state counters listed in semantic_projection_counter_excludes projected out, and nothing else. It is the load-bearing binding: it stays stable across any future licensed counter increment, so a change to a threshold, gate, ontology entry, population figure, comparator role, status rule or execution-state prose cannot hide behind a routine state update. Audit G rejected the earlier design, which projected out the whole execution_state block: excluding a container also excludes the free text inside it, and that text could then be rewritten to assert a completed evaluation without moving the hash.

phase_1_2g_finalization_snapshot.role: Immutable snapshot of the execution_state block as the Phase 1.2G policy finalized it. It is history, not live state; live state is live_counters below.

values.final_policy_is_not_a_result: status=FINAL records that the rule for judging a future evaluation is settled. It records nothing about any parser. Parser v3 remains unvalidated, parser-v3-v1 remains SEALED / UNSPENT / UNSCORABLE / RETIRED_AS_INELIGIBLE, no set exists for parser-v3-v2, and no evaluation has been run.

counter_semantics.retired_v1_repair_access: Access to the retired parser-v3-v1 sealed set for repair purposes only. A semantic read decodes case content; a byte-only integrity verification streams bytes to a digest and discards them. They are counted separately because only the first changes what a human has seen.
counter_semantics.formal_v2_evaluation_access: Access to a future sealed parser-v3-v2 set for formal evaluation. Distinct from repair access: a repair read must never be reported as, or aggregated with, an evaluation read.
counter_semantics.v2_construction: Construction, sealing, listing-witness and final-contract activity for the successor set.
counter_semantics.parser_execution: Parser invocations and prediction generation. Must remain zero for the whole of Phase 1.2H.
counter_semantics.azure: Control-plane reads are configuration and existence queries. Data-plane content reads and writes are object access. They are separate because a reachability probe is not a data access.

events.summary: Verified HEAD == origin/main == 0480f4fae869090d8bd2abc72373e9a0e1dd3e49, clean worktree, focused suite 446 passed, full suite 1821 passed.

Streamed the two local retired-v1 curator files to SHA-256 and compared digest and byte count against the committed public set manifest. Both matched. Bytes were discarded; no record was decoded, parsed, printed or retained.

Resolved the registered authoritative sealed source from committed evidence and probed reachability at the control plane and at the container metadata layer only. The storage account reports publicNetworkAccess=Disabled and the data plane refused the request under its network rules. The registered set prefix was never listed and no object was requested.

The authoritative retired-v1 source cannot be authenticated or read with the required read-only boundary from this environment, so the local curator copy may not be substituted for it. Round terminated BLOCKED_ON_PRIVATE_SOURCE_ACCESS before any private access.

retired_v1_state.repair_access_purpose: none exercised; this round did not reach the authoritative source
retired_v1_state.current_state_note: The Phase 1.2H state transition to REPAIR_ACCESSED did NOT occur, because no semantic read of the retired source took place. UNSPENT therefore remains accurate without qualification.

successor_set_state.sealed_object_count_note: null, not zero. Under limitation L-32 a sealed member list and sealed_object_count require an authenticated seal-time observation. No set was sealed, so the quantity is undefined rather than measured to be zero, and an offline assertion must not stand in for the observation.
